name: asr_robustness
description: How extraction behaves when the SAME sentence is spoken by different people, at different rates, with different accents, through an 8 kHz beamformed mic. NOT A VOICE TEST — no audio, no microphone, no recogniser is involved. These are the textual signatures that those conditions leave in an SFSpeechRecognizer transcript: elided function words at speed, fillers and repetitions when hesitant, consonant confusions in narrowband, truncation when a phrase is cut, crosstalk when two people overlap, and spelling substitutions when a name is unfamiliar to the recogniser. Expectations encode INTENDED behaviour. Two rules govern them: a degradation that leaves the name intact should still bind (recall), and a degradation that corrupts the name must never assert a wrong one (precision). Real word error rates come from gate G1 on the glasses, not from this file.
